newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury pulled up by Grand Met/Guinness deal.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury pulled up by Grand Met/Guinness deal.

text.p: Shares in Cadbury Schweppes Plc advanced on Monday as news of a merger between Grand Metropolitan Plc and Guinness Plc raised hopes of further consolidation in the in the consumer foods and drinks sector, dealers said.
By 0930 GMT the shares were up 11p, or 2.1 percent, to 540p.
Gains in GrandMet and Guinness shares -- each up about 13 percent -- spilled over into others in the sector. Shares in Allied Domecq Plc advanced 5-1/2p to 434.
Dealers said unexpected news of the 20 billion pound deal reignited talk that Cadbury may be the next company involved in a takeover or merger.
One London dealer said old rumours that Unilever Plc could bid for Cadbury had re-emerged.

"These rumours tend to ebb and flow, but I think there may more foundation this time around because of what's happening in the sector and because of Unilever's cash position," he said, noting Unilever's recent sale of its speciality chemical business.
